name: Antigravity-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 4 has the fullest ring of particles evenly around the hollow centre.

tagline: Tiny pink capsules orbit a hollow ring, repelled by the pointer.
summary: Hundreds of small pink particles gather into a loose ring around the pointer and shove outward as it moves, drifting across a black field.
appearance: A black field scattered with hundreds of short pink-white capsules, most gathered in a rough circle that leaves a dark hole in the middle. Outside the ring a few stray particles float.
behaviour: Particles near the pointer swing into a ring around it, pointing outward, and part as it moves; the ring breathes with a slow pulse. Left alone, the ring drifts along its own path.
search_phrases: particles that flee from the cursor
ring of dots around the mouse
floating specks in a dark field
pink specks pushed away by pointer
dark particle field for a hero
use_when: A product page wants a light particle halo that reacts to the pointer without a heavy scene.
avoid_when: The particles are sparse and low contrast, so the ring is faint on anything but pure black.
customise: Particle count, magnet and ring radius, wave speed and amplitude, size, lerp, colour, auto animation, variance, rotation, depth, pulse, shape and field strength are props.
weight_why: Three hundred instanced capsules are recomputed and re-uploaded every frame on one draw call.

a11y.note: Decorative particles with no controls; the field keeps animating and ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The particles are faint and sparse, leaving large areas of pure black.
The ring follows pointer motion only, so the field is nearly still when the mouse is idle.
polish_why: The ring of particles is tidy and calm; it is sparse and reads as a simple dot field.
title: Antigravity Particle Field
